description: Three white paper cups are stacked together on a light wooden table in front of you, with empty space around them. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the stacked cups near the rim while the left hand comes in low to steady them; the right hand lifts the top cup off, moves it left, and sets it down, then returns to take another cup from the remaining stack and places it down so the cups end up unstacked in a row with both hands releasing.
